title: Directory Submission Plan
one_line: Pick the directories and marketplaces worth listing on, and prepare one set of assets that fits all of them.
description: Pick the directories and marketplaces worth listing on, and prepare one set of assets that fits all of them. Use when launching a tool, when someone asks where to list a product, or when directory submissions are eating time for no return.
paragraph: Directory submission is usually done as a volume exercise against a list of a hundred sites, most of which send nobody. This skill ranks by whether a directory actually sends traffic to listings like yours, then prepares one asset set that satisfies the field requirements of all the ones that made the cut, so the submissions take an afternoon rather than a month.
keywords: where should i list my product
approval_stop: submitting the listing to any directory
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
